description: Transfer a domain in to Impreza from another registrar. Needs the EPP/auth code, which the customer gets from their CURRENT registrar, and the domain has to be unlocked there and older than 60 days. Costs money — usually one year of registration, added to the expiry rather than replacing it. Registries take days, not minutes, and the losing registrar emails the owner to approve; impreza_domain_registrar_action can resend that mail. Requires the 'manage' scope. If confirm_token is absent from this connection's input schema, use a connection that exposes it or a supported customer-portal flow. A quote or confirmation request is not completion. COSTS MONEY — takes two calls: the first is a QUOTE that charges nothing and returns the price plus a confirm_token, the second repeats the same arguments plus confirm_token and buys. Purchases also count against a daily spend ceiling on the credential.

domain.description: Domain to transfer in, e.g. example.com.

epp_code.description: Authorisation / EPP code from the current registrar. Treat it as a credential.

name: impreza_domain_transfer
title: Transfer domain in
